      Backup & Device Transfer

      This web app saves locally and works offline after the first visit. Use a sync code or backup file to move the same characters, checks, and custom quest order between devices. Automatic account-based cloud sync can be connected as the next deployment step.

      Tip: after making changes on one device, copy a fresh sync code and import it on the other device. The imported version replaces the checklist data on that device.

      Reset rules: Dailies reset every day at 5:00 AM UTC+7. Weeklies reset Monday at 5:00 AM UTC+7. Quest order, custom quests, and character profiles are saved on this device. Prontera music may need one tap to start because mobile browsers block sound autoplay.
